title: Plugins: who can install a Copilot plugin, and how do you block one?
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents preview Graph automation for both publisher-category access and tenant-wide User access, which the page incorrectly reports as undocumented. The Word legal-plugin route is supported across two cited pages, but its control link omits the page that actually names the setting.

claims.claim: Publisher-category access is configured in Microsoft 365 admin center at Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access.
claims.quote: Select Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access. Under the installation settings, choose which publisher categories users can access: Microsoft, your organization, or certified external publishers.
claims.fix: Extend the path to 'Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access > installation settings'; retain the note identifying the three publisher categories.

claims.claim: Tenant-wide user access is configured in Microsoft 365 admin center at Agents > Settings > User access.
claims.quote: Select Agents > Settings > User access to manage your organization's agents and plugins.

claims.claim: An individual plugin's user availability is configured at Agents > Tools > Plugins > plugin > Users.
claims.quote: Select Agents > Tools > Plugins. Select the plugin that you want to manage. Open Users, and then choose one of the following availability options:

claims.claim: PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id} sets plugin availability through availableTo and allowedUsersAndGroups.
Administrator installation is reached at Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Tools > plugin > Install.
claims.quote: Select Agents > Tools. From the list, select the plugin or skill that you want to install, and then select Install.
claims.fix: Keep the path, but append to the note: 'In the installation pane, choose All users or Specific users or groups, then select Next and Install.' The printed route reaches the opening Install action rather than the audience selection.

claims.claim: PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id} sets the deployment audience through deployedTo and acquireUsersAndGroups.
Package blocking is reached at Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Tools > Plugins > plugin > Block.
claims.quote: Select Agents > Tools > Plugins. From the list, select the plugin or skill that you want to block. Select Block, and then select Block again to confirm.

claims.claim: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block prevents package usage.
claims.quote:
Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block

claims.claim: The cited Cloud Policy overview documents the route through Configure Settings to Legal Skills in M365 Copilot in Word.
claims.quote: Searched: "Legal Skills in M365 Copilot in Word" PowerShell Graph API Cloud Policy; opened overview-cloud-policy and manage-copilot-for-legal. The overview gives the wizard route but not the final policy name; manage-copilot-for-legal gives that name.
claims.fix: Keep the path, but change controls[5].ui.docs to https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/manage/manage-copilot-for-legal, which names the setting. Keep https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/admin-center/overview-cloud-policy in sources for the wizard route.
